FAIL_TO_PASS: mark-namespace-members: marks namespace members
supports-es6-shim: supports es6-shim
computed-properties: Resolve template literals in computed property keys

array-expression: Tree-shake known array prototype functions

invalid-property-calls: includes invalid property calls
compact: compact output with compact: true
side-effects-getters-and-setters: treat getters and setters as function calls
recursive-computed-members: handle recursive computed member access

dynamic-namespace-lookup: does namespace optimization when possible, but not for dynamic lookups
side-effect-es5-classes: omits ES5 classes which are pure (e.g. they only assign to `this`)
synthetic-named-exports: synthetic named exports
nested-deoptimization: handles deoptimization of nested properties
unknown-property-access: handles getters that modify "this" for unknown property access

array-mutation: tracks mutations of array elements
